examples.email_body: Hi John, I need you to approve the attached wire transfer request for the new vendor. This is time-sensitive and must be completed before EOD. Let me know if you have questions.
indicators: Sender email address mimics CEO but uses a lookalike domain
Urgency to bypass normal verification processes
Targeted specifically at CFO role responsible for wire transfers

examples.email_subject: Request for Employee Salary Data for Audit
examples.email_body: Dear Sarah, the external auditors require an updated salary report for all employees by tomorrow. Please find the template attached and send the completed document once done.
indicators: Email impersonates trusted audit firm known to HR
Request for sensitive employee salary data
Attachment contains malicious macros to steal credentials
Targeted at HR Manager who handles employee records

examples.email_body: Hello Mike, our security team has detected vulnerabilities in your system. Please download and install the attached patch to prevent potential breaches.
indicators: Sender address appears internal but is spoofed
Attachment is an executable file disguised as a security update
Targets IT Administrator responsible for system security
Creates sense of urgency to lower suspicion
